00.name: Sour
00.text: Seriously, your choosing to go right. Lame.

01.name: Sweat
01.text: Thank you for choosing correctly mortal, and not being persuaded by those of a lesser intelect.

03.name: Sweat
03.text: I never said your name. It was you that presumed I was talking about you.

05.name: Sweat
05.text: Nevermind Sour. Let's keep going lord Pasta can't be hept waiting.

06.name: Narrator
06.text: After walking for a while you round a bend only to find a fallen tree blocking the trail.

07.name: Sour
07.text: Ha, see. I told you we shouldn't have come this way but nooo we all have to listen to Sweat.

08.name: Sweat
08.text: How was I supposed to know that a tree was blocking the way.

09.name: Sweat
09.text: Mortal put that axe to good use and clear the tree from the path.
